sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Sense of falling through bed and floor.
Pains from below upward. . Tired and nervous.

Frontal headache to root of nose. Dizzy. Pressing
feeling in head.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Illusion of vision with wide open eyes.
Twitching of lids. Photophobia, objects blurred. Ach-
ing in eyes and lids. Marked dilation of pupils. Fail-
ure to react to light, particularly daylight.

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Profuse fluent coryza. Especially in after-
noon. Violent sneezing.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Heavy limbs, cold legs, exaggerated
knee-jerk. Pains from below upward.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Eruption like measles. Perspiration on side
not lain upt^n. Itching all over back.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text: Worse at night. Worse right side.
